messages:
Nora: Heads upSunday pick'em reminder! Submit lineups by 2pm or you'll auto-submit last week's. :alarm_clock:
Liam: on it. Also, waiver wire picks? My bench is a curse. :cry:
Zoe: PSA: Marcus dropped J. Rivers last night. Free to a good home.
Marcus: i regret nothing. Bench was crowded + trade deadline looming :sweat_smile:
Ivy: trade drama incoming. Can we please not do 1am "panic trades" again. Learned that lesson 2022.
Nora: Also food logistics: I can bring sliders and napkins. @snack-bot add "vegan option" to the list
snack-bot: Snack list updated  sliders (Nora). Added: vegan option (unclaimed). Reply `claim: item` to take it.
Liam: claim: chips and dip
Zoe: Ill bring a veggie tray for the vegan option. Marcus, you bringing buns?
Marcus: yup buns secured. Also voting on pregame tunes: 80s rock vs pump-up EDM. React with :guitar: for 80s, :zap: for EDM
Ivy: :zap: EDM all day
Liam: :guitar: (dont @ me)
Nora: Quick waiver question: does anyone want J. Rivers for a week? I'll drop P. Hayes if so.
Zoe: I'll take Rivers for now, but we should set a reminder to re-evaluate Sunday night.
Marcus: also reminder about parking: 2 guest spots by loading dock first-come. Please carpool if you can.
Ivy: tiny meme: "my team when clock hits 0:00" https://imgur.com/fakegif :joy:
Liam: lol love it. May the best hot-take win.
Nora: Closing note: winner of the pick'em owes coffee run Monday AM. Stakes are high. :coffee:
